{{- /* layouts/_partials/social-icons.html CAP-06: Unified social icon entry point. Usage (pass the socials slice): {{- partial "social-icons.html" .Site.Author.Socials -}} {{- partial "social-icons.html" .Site.Home.Params.author.socials -}} Dual-source key compatibility: config.toml [[author.socials]] → keys are capitalized (.ID, .Link) index.md frontmatter → keys are lowercase (.id, .link) Both are supported via: .id | default .ID Config schema (config.toml): [author] name = "Author Name" [[author.socials]] id = "github" ← platform key; SVG looked up from svgs/social/{id}.html link = "https://github.com/username" Supported platform IDs: github, twitter, linkedin, youtube, instagram, discord, email, website, tiktok, reddit, weibo, zhihu, bilibili Sub-theme extension: add layouts/_partials/svgs/social/.html for additional platforms. */ -}} {{- range . -}} {{- $id := .id | default .ID -}} {{- $link := .link | default .Link -}} {{- if and $id $link -}} {{- partial (printf "svgs/social/%s.html" $id) . -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}}
